status: Proposed balance values; economy and route arithmetic verified, gameplay pacing untested

worlds.name: Broken asteroid
worlds.mechanic: Learn controlled digging, cargo limits and return reserve. The first two marked seams retain the original 380 and 480 credit gross rewards.
worlds.hazard: Gravity 0.55g. Brittle shelves fall after a 2.0 s crack warning; hit 3 HP. Starting safe route contains no unavoidable shelf.
worlds.shape: Angular broken plates, large quiet cavities and rectangular salvage. Ore silhouettes use chips and short crystal teeth.
worlds.rig: Orange battered cabin, exposed bolts and mismatched plates; R1 front auger, R2 folding feet, R3 rear rack.
worlds.light: Warm headlamp is the brightest moving object. Cool distant stars remain subordinate to the traversable foreground.
worlds.fx: Short grey chips on cuts; two visible dust puffs before shelf failure. No constant full-screen dust.
worlds.audio: Dry pneumatic knock, ticking fuel pump, restrained metallic percussion. Cargo pickup has a short rising two-note cue.
milestones: Survey the wreck
Reach the marked beacon at 100 m and bank any three ore deposits. Unlock R2 and a surface service dock.
Recover the lander parts
Recover a valve at 250 m and an antenna at 400 m; bank both. Unlock R3 and the star map.
Restore the lander
Retrieve the navigation core at 600 m and complete construction. Grant Frontier certificate; open W02 and W03.

gear.name: Salvaged auger
gear.effect: Soil cut time x0.90; all other material unchanged. Passive drill attachment.
gear.art: Three broad steel flutes, chipped orange collar, one white tooth marker.

gear.name: Anchoring feet
gear.effect: Deploy in 0.35 s. While held on a solid edge, horizontal drift -60% and thrust energy -20%; drilling still allowed.
gear.art: Two hinged rectangular feet; deployed feet gain a striped mechanical contact indicator.

gear.name: External cargo rack
gear.effect: Cargo capacity +20%, rounded down; acceleration -8% while loaded. Removable cargo attachment.
gear.art: Two open rear cages; fill from bottom upward with visible crate silhouettes.

jackpot_item.name: Broken asteroid relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Navigation core
quest_item.shape: Square avionics block with two unequal antenna stubs and a white navigation cross

worlds.name: Ice comet
worlds.mechanic: Choose fast melting or intact extraction. Release drilling within 0.75 s of a volatile completion cue to preserve the package; continuing beyond that window ruptures it. The tutorial demonstrates this safely.
worlds.hazard: Gravity 0.35g. Cold pockets apply -25% acceleration for 4 s after a 1.5 s mist warning. Ice vent hit 6 HP, once per 3 s contact.
worlds.shape: Long ice facets, smooth melt channels and round trapped bubbles. Preserve crisp dark outlines at ice boundaries.
worlds.rig: Insulated pale panels around the orange cabin; transparent condenser tubes and a hooded warm drill tip.
worlds.light: Blue ambient light with warm drill contact. Volatiles pulse slowly in a steady turquoise halo.
worlds.fx: Steam travels upward, frost fragments fall, intact pickup uses a clean ring rather than an explosion.
worlds.audio: Glass ticks, damped motor, descending breath for vent warnings; a bell confirms intact extraction.
milestones: Sample the thermal seam
Bank five Helion-tagged sample deposits from the marked 150 m vein. Samples have no cash value. Unlock R2 and a heated refuge.
Recover without rupture
Bank three intact cryosilicate deposits from 450 m; warning feedback is shown before the first attempt. Unlock R3.
Stabilize the comet fuel
Retrieve the catalyst at 1000 m and finish the condenser project. Grant Planetary certificate; open W04.

gear.name: Thermal auger
gear.effect: Ice cut time x0.55. Drilling energy x1.20 while this tool is active. Ordinary rock cut time unchanged.
gear.art: Copper annulus around three white ceramic teeth; warm internal slit.

gear.name: Vapour condenser
gear.effect: Recover 20% of drilling energy spent on ice, after extraction. Recovery cannot exceed the energy spent on that cut.
gear.art: Twin transparent tubes with readable rising bubbles; intake faces the drill.

gear.name: Preservation chamber
gear.effect: Hold precision mode: volatile cut time x1.35; intact volatile sale value +30%. Bonus excludes mission objects and jackpots.
gear.art: Small hexagonal insulated chest with a visible suspended crystal and a slow status light.

jackpot_item.name: Ice comet relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Cryogenic catalyst
quest_item.shape: Teardrop ice capsule with one copper loop and a suspended bright seed

worlds.name: Fractured moon
worlds.mechanic: Map faults and secure traversable tunnels. Supports protect a local route, not the whole mine; old unsupported areas remain interesting.
worlds.hazard: Gravity 0.75g. Ceiling collapse deals 12 HP after 2.5 s cracks and a dust stream. One supported pocket is guaranteed at each objective.
worlds.shape: Horizontal strata interrupted by large diagonal fractures. Use broken arches and off-centre rock columns.
worlds.rig: Tall sensor mast and vertical supports; broad feet maintain a low centre of mass around the same cabin.
worlds.light: Cold diffuse surface light, warm pocket lamps. Unstable edges gain a patterned amber outline only when scanned.
worlds.fx: Dust trails precede moving blocks. Scanner rings stop on geometry and never obscure ore edges.
worlds.audio: Low stone strain, distinct two-stage crack warning, soft sonar ping with directional stereo.
milestones: Read the first fault
Scan the marked fault at 150 m and return its survey. Unlock R2 and the first supported shaft segment.
Build the safe crossing
Scan the 500 m fault, place two supports across it and cross with saleable cargo. Bank the second survey. Unlock R3.
Recover the archive
Retrieve the archive at 1000 m with two completed fault surveys. Grant Planetary certificate; open W04.

gear.name: Seismic scanner
gear.effect: Reveal ore and unstable tiles within 6 cells for 5 s; 12 s cooldown; 0.25 energy per pulse.
gear.art: Forked mast with a single broad dish; three concentric scan marks on its icon.

gear.name: Shaft supports
gear.effect: Deploy up to 4 supports per expedition. Each prevents collapse within 2 cells; placements persist. Restore deployment charges at dock for free.
gear.art: Telescoping I-beam with diagonal foot and black-yellow edge pattern.

gear.name: Tether winch
gear.effect: Anchor to visible solid rock within 8 cells. Reel speed 5 cells/s, energy 0.10/s; 10 s cooldown after detaching.
gear.art: Large open spool with thick cable and triangular hook; cable remains visible against rock.

jackpot_item.name: Fractured moon relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Seismic archive
quest_item.shape: Stack of three engraved stone discs clamped inside a survey bracket

worlds.name: Iron planet
worlds.mechanic: Industrial excavation and deliberate haul planning. Retain the original six-region depth arc but regenerate its economy and objective routes for this campaign.
worlds.hazard: Gravity 1.0g. Stone material multiplier 1.85. Deep pressure vent hit 12 HP after 2 s warning. Core rank 4 unlocks at M1, not on landing.
worlds.shape: Thick horizontal iron bands, cut metal-like faces and compact industrial ruins. Maintain large low-detail rock masses.
worlds.rig: Hydraulic pistons, square compression bay and magnetic separators; ivory pressure shell retains orange identification stripe.
worlds.light: Rust ambient tones, neutral steel highlights, white mineral glints. Magma edges remain clearly bounded.
worlds.fx: Heavy chips travel a short distance. Hydraulic recoil is confined to the tool and never shakes the entire screen by default.
worlds.audio: Slow heavy piston rhythm, cargo clamp thunk, lower motor pitch under high load.
milestones: Establish the deep relay
Bank samples from 900 m and install the relay at 1800 m. Unlock R2, core rank 4 and prepared-shaft travel.
Open the pressure route
Cut three marked dense plugs near 3800 m, then bank one load through the relay. Unlock R3.
Retrieve the geothermal core
Reach 5950 m, extract the core and complete the orbital dock. Open W05 and W06.

gear.name: Hydraulic crown
gear.effect: Stone cut time x0.70. Cutting stone consumes +15% drilling energy; soil unchanged.
gear.art: Four large blunt teeth, exposed piston pair and a rectangular pressure gauge.

gear.name: Magnetic separator
gear.effect: Ferrous ordinary deposits sell for +25% and occupy 1 less bulk, minimum 1. Other tags, jackpots and mission items are unchanged.
gear.art: Twin horseshoe poles beside the cargo intake; three metallic chips visibly separate.

gear.name: Ore compactor
gear.effect: Ordinary deposit bulk x0.75, rounded down with minimum 1 per package; mass unchanged. Energy 0.15 per accepted package.
gear.art: Opposed square press jaws with one broad crush arrow; four-stage press animation.

jackpot_item.name: Iron planet relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Geothermal core
quest_item.shape: Heavy six-sided basalt vessel with an enclosed orange core

worlds.name: Ocean moon
worlds.mechanic: Control buoyancy and currents while protecting the return path. Landing includes shallow pressure protection; the first marked income vein lies within that safe band.
worlds.hazard: Water drag x1.4; gravity 0.9g. Base safe pressure depth 400 m. Beyond rating: 12 HP/s after a 5 s warning. Current bands push at 1.5 cells/s.
worlds.shape: Rounded pressure-smoothed shelves, tubular vents and sweeping current lines. Silhouettes stay opaque against water.
worlds.rig: Sealed cabin gasket, twin cyan ballast pods, protected front cutter and bright top rescue lamp.
worlds.light: Petrol blue background, clear turquoise task lights and amber hazard strips. Avoid glowing every organism or mineral.
worlds.fx: Bubble motion indicates current direction. Pressure warnings add hull bands and a gauge tick, never blur.
worlds.audio: Low-pass ambience, sonar pulses, rising pressure creak; all critical cues have visible counterparts.
milestones: Commission the pressure dock
Bank five tagged samples from the safe 250 m shelf. Unlock R2 and a service bell.
Map the current route
Activate three current beacons at 700, 1100 and 1600 m and return once. Unlock R3.
Raise the abyssal seal
Recover the seal at 2500 m and finish the pressure dock. Grant Stellar certificate; open W07 and W09.

gear.name: Pressure hull
gear.effect: Safe pressure depth becomes 3000 m. Pressure damage -60%; other damage unchanged. Permanent integrated protection.
gear.art: Ivory overlapping shell rings with dark gasket seams and circular inspection ports.

gear.name: Ballast control
gear.effect: Choose neutral, rise or sink mode. Water control acceleration +35%; movement energy in water -15%.
gear.art: Two readable translucent side tanks with a moving waterline and opposing arrows.

gear.name: Cavitation cutter
gear.effect: Submerged rock cut time x0.60. Creates a 1.5 s bubble pulse; tool energy x1.15.
gear.art: Three-ring nozzle with a hollow central cutting aperture; bubble ring stays local.

jackpot_item.name: Ocean moon relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Abyssal pressure seal
quest_item.shape: Round ivory pressure seal with four large clamps and a turquoise centre

worlds.name: Volcanic world
worlds.mechanic: Store environmental heat and spend it on excavation bursts. Cooling refuges are always reachable before unavoidable exposure would fill the heat meter.
worlds.hazard: Heat 0-100; hot zone +8/s, drilling there +6/s extra, refuge -20/s. At 100: 18 HP each 2 s until heat <80. Edge warning starts at 75.
worlds.shape: Dark basalt shelves, thick glowing fissures and solid ceramic ruins. Magma uses striped hot edges and flowing interiors.
worlds.rig: Ivory ceramic segments, broad radiator fins and a visible thermal vessel behind the cabin.
worlds.light: Glows occupy less than 15% of the visible field; terrain edges remain darker than the player lamp.
worlds.fx: Heat shimmer is confined to background and can be disabled. Vent direction is visible before eruption.
worlds.audio: Thermal ticking, intermittent low roars and a three-beat overheat warning.
milestones: Instrument the first vent
Measure a marked vent at 250 m and return below 75 heat. Unlock R2 and the first cooling refuge.
Power the thermal relay
Spend 60 stored heat units while opening the marked six-cell basalt corridor near 1200 m. Unlock R3.
Extract the regulator
Recover the regulator at 2500 m, then finish the cooling plant. Grant Stellar certificate; open W07 and W09.

gear.name: Ceramic crown
gear.effect: Heat gained from drilling -40%; basalt cut time x0.80. Environmental heat remains unchanged.
gear.art: Broad pale ceramic teeth with a dark outer ring and minimal orange wear.

gear.name: Heat exchanger
gear.effect: Store up to 60 heat units absorbed from the environment. Each stored unit consumed offsets 0.02 drilling energy; cannot recharge from its own discharge.
gear.art: Six large radiator fins feeding an amber glass reservoir with a clear fill line.

gear.name: Thermal burst
gear.effect: Spend 20 stored heat to obtain cut time x0.60 for 5 s; 15 s cooldown. Cannot stack with another active drill burst.
gear.art: Open radiator iris and a three-step orange light bar; short outward vent on activation.

jackpot_item.name: Volcanic world relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Thermal regulator
quest_item.shape: Ceramic regulator shaped like a broad tuning fork around an amber vessel

worlds.name: Gas giant reefs
worlds.mechanic: Mine solid condensate reefs suspended in atmosphere. Plan movement between shelter pockets and turn telegraphed lightning into stored power.
worlds.hazard: Gravity 0.7g. Crosswind 2 cells/s in marked bands. Lightning hit 30 HP; 2 s aim warning, minimum 12 s interval in exposed zones.
worlds.shape: Floating flat-bottom mineral shelves, broad cloud bands and downward hanging growths. Keep landing silhouettes readable.
worlds.rig: Vector jets under each corner, folded storm rods and a capacitive drum with broad gold bands.
worlds.light: Clouds are low contrast; reefs and the rig stay opaque. Lightning flashes use bounded local illumination.
worlds.fx: Wind ribbons curve around shelters. Capacitor arcs connect only clearly visible nodes.
worlds.audio: Directional wind, clear rising electrical warning, short capacitor charging tone.
milestones: Calibrate the vector system
Visit three sheltered reef beacons within the first 400 m. Unlock R2 and the weather dock.
Bank storm energy
Capture two telegraphed strikes safely and bank 40 stored energy units. Unlock R3.
Recover the storm core
Extract the core on the 1800 m reef and complete the containment frame. Grant Stellar charge certificate; open W08.

gear.name: Vector thrusters
gear.effect: Airborne acceleration +30%; wind displacement -50%; movement energy x1.10.
gear.art: Four short nozzles, each with a broad swivel joint; clear direction during thrust.

gear.name: Storm capacitor
gear.effect: Captures a strike while grounded on a storm pad: +20 energy into a 60-unit reservoir, once per 12 s. Capture grants no saleable cargo.
gear.art: Two vertical rods and a central dark-blue cylinder with three gold charge bands.

gear.name: Electrostatic collector
gear.effect: Gather exposed ordinary deposits within 2 cells after cutting their support. Energy 0.4 per package; no collection through solid rock.
gear.art: Open fork above the intake with two short attracting arcs and an opaque cargo silhouette.

jackpot_item.name: Gas giant reefs relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Storm capacitor core
quest_item.shape: Short navy cylinder capped by two lightning rods and three gold charge bands

worlds.name: Stellar corona
worlds.mechanic: Excavate crystallized condensate held in magnetic lattices. Safe chambers make this recognizably a mining map even though the surroundings are stellar plasma.
worlds.hazard: Shielded arrival chamber is safe. Exposed flare cycle: 3 s warning, 4 s flare, 11 s quiet. Unprotected hit 45 HP per 2 s. No full-screen white flashes.
worlds.shape: Concentric magnetic ribs, heavy mineral lattices and sharply cut safe chambers. The star is background, never a solid ordinary planet.
worlds.rig: Gold containment rings around dark-blue ceramic plating. The original cabin and orange stripe remain visible.
worlds.light: Brightest plasma is outside the playable silhouette band. Safe chambers have steady pale-blue edge lamps.
worlds.fx: Magnetic arcs bend around the rig, cuts release contained ribbons. Flare warning uses expanding patterned bands.
worlds.audio: Sustained reactor harmonic, rising flare cue and a clear quiet-window downbeat.
milestones: Tune the containment field
Run a 20 s calibration in the safe chamber and bank three lattice samples. Unlock R2 and a cooling dock.
Sustain the extraction
Accumulate 90 s of extraction at the marked 1300 m lattice across any number of quiet windows; bank progress at the relay. Unlock R3.
Forge the drive seed
Extract the seed at 2400 m and complete the drive frame. Grant Spatial certificate; open W10 and W12.

gear.name: Magnetic containment
gear.effect: Flare damage -75%; passive shield drains 0.04 energy/s only during exposed flares. Empty energy disables reduction after a 2 s warning.
gear.art: Two thick gold rings, navy mounts and four bright field nodes.

gear.name: Plasma lance
gear.effect: Crystalline material cut time x0.55; drill energy x1.25 while active. No drilling through unopened mission locks.
gear.art: Long tapered aperture with a narrow bright core and dark outer shroud.

gear.name: Radiation recuperator
gear.effect: While shielded in an external flare, harvest 0.8 energy/s, capped at 3.2 per flare. Own emissions never count; no recovery while docked or in refuge.
gear.art: Shield collar with three reflective panels and a small inward-flowing light sequence.

jackpot_item.name: Stellar corona relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Stellar drive seed
quest_item.shape: Small tetrahedral luminous seed held inside a thick gold containment ring

worlds.name: White dwarf remnant
worlds.mechanic: Anchor the rig to extract dense deposits. This is a science-fantasy remnant crust; extraction windows are introduced one at a time.
worlds.hazard: Effective gravity 1.8g before bracing. Compression faults hit 30 HP after 2.5 s warning. Every objective has a guaranteed stable anchoring edge.
worlds.shape: Compressed diamond faces, vertical ribs and narrow supported cavities. Pale faces contrast against deep navy void.
worlds.rig: Wide deployed legs, heavy steel collar and a compact cubic cargo chamber.
worlds.light: Cool specular rim light is restrained to edges. Stress lines are amber with a chevron pattern.
worlds.fx: Short radial pressure ripples and dense chips. Fault direction is indicated by converging lines.
worlds.audio: Low mechanical strain, slow compression beat and a firm anchor-lock click.
milestones: Anchor the survey platform
Deploy on the marked stable edge at 300 m and bank three dense samples. Unlock R2.
Open the compression vault
Extract two lattice plugs at 1100 m while anchored; progress persists. Unlock R3 and the deep dock.
Lift the stabilizer core
Recover the core at 2200 m and finish the field assembly. Grant Stellar charge certificate; open W08.

gear.name: Gravitic braces
gear.effect: Deploy in 0.5 s on a solid edge. While deployed, gravity and external displacement x0.35; movement disabled, drilling allowed.
gear.art: Four thick spread legs with large triangular feet and a locked ring above the cabin.

gear.name: Lattice cutter
gear.effect: Dense and crystalline cut time x0.65 while anchored; otherwise x0.90. Energy x1.10.
gear.art: Six blunt geometric teeth around a central square void.

gear.name: Compression containers
gear.effect: Dense ordinary cargo bulk x0.50, rounded down with minimum 1; mass x0.70. Does not stack with Ore compactor; choose either.
gear.art: Nested metal cubes with a clear inward arrow and an illuminated central latch.

jackpot_item.name: White dwarf remnant relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Gravitic stabilizer core
quest_item.shape: Dense dark cube suspended between four pale triangular gravitic braces

worlds.name: Accretion belt
worlds.mechanic: Mine tethered fragments while tidal fields change the safest return route. The camera remains stable; world motion is indicated through local debris.
worlds.hazard: Tidal push 3 cells/s in marked lanes. Shear hit 60 HP after 3 s warning. Detached ore floats for 30 s before loss; secured cargo never expires.
worlds.shape: Long torn rock wedges and offset orbit arcs. A dark distant disk communicates scale without dominating the map.
worlds.rig: Offset inertial frame, external tether spool and thick cross braces; slight counter-rotation inside the frame only.
worlds.light: Burgundy shadows, warm mineral edges and pale cyan tether lines. Safe anchors use solid square lamps.
worlds.fx: Debris indicates tidal direction. Extraction tethers never disappear behind decorative particles.
worlds.audio: Deep periodic pulls, cable tension and a two-tone shear warning.
milestones: Fix the first orbit anchor
Reach the 300 m stable fragment and bank one ordinary package by normal pickup. Unlock R2 and the tether dock.
Recover across the shear lane
Secure and bank three marked ore packages from the 1200 m lane. Unlock R3.
Extract the inertial core
Recover the core at 2200 m and finish the navigation anchor. Grant Rift certificate; open W11.

gear.name: Inertial stabilizer
gear.effect: External push -55%; acceleration remains unchanged. Movement energy x1.08.
gear.art: Two offset hoops on a stout rectangular frame with a central counterweight.

gear.name: Extraction tether
gear.effect: Secure one exposed package within 8 cells; reel at 4 cells/s, 0.12 energy/s. A secured package ignores the drift expiry timer.
gear.art: Large cyan-lit spool with a heavy triangular hook and striped cable.

gear.name: Tidal brace
gear.effect: Hold brace for up to 6 s: shear damage -60%, movement -40%; 15 s cooldown after release.
gear.art: Two broad clamps close around the chassis; icon shows converging chevrons.

jackpot_item.name: Accretion belt relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Inertial anchor core
quest_item.shape: Paired unequal hoops holding a solid rust-red core

worlds.name: Wormhole junction
worlds.mechanic: Build a route across six disconnected chambers. Depth denotes cumulative expedition distance, not a single vertical shaft.
worlds.hazard: Portal mouths telegraph instability for 3 s; rupture hit 100 HP. No portal may strand the player without a return opening or recovery route.
worlds.shape: Rock chambers end in clean oval apertures. Linked portals share a number and border pattern, not just a colour.
worlds.rig: Compact rig with paired anchor rings and a rear cargo relay housing; silhouette remains solid during travel.
worlds.light: Cyan portals have dark central openings; destinations are previewed with a small terrain silhouette.
worlds.fx: Cargo and rig cross in discrete readable steps. Avoid disorienting full-screen warps.
worlds.audio: Paired portal tones, short arrival confirmation and a steady instability tick.
milestones: Stabilize the entrance pair
Connect the two marked anchors in chamber 1 and return through them. Unlock R2.
Build the cargo route
Bank three packages through a relay across chambers 2 and 4. Unlock R3 and the midpoint dock.
Align the junction
Activate anchors in chambers 3, 5 and 6, bank the coordinate and complete the array. Grant Dimensional certificate; open W13 and W14.

gear.name: Spatial anchors
gear.effect: Maintain one placed portal pair at a time on discovered empty cells within the current chamber network. Maximum pair separation 20 cells; 30 s replacement cooldown.
gear.art: Two oval frames with matching notches and a small numerical label plate.

gear.name: Entangled cargo relay
gear.effect: At an installed relay, bank up to 25% of current bay capacity per expedition. Cargo must already be collected; relay does not sell or refuel.
gear.art: Split cargo box joined by a short luminous bar; transfer fills a four-segment indicator.

gear.name: Portal winch
gear.effect: Pull one visible exposed package through a stable portal, range 6 cells on its destination side; 0.5 energy/package.
gear.art: Open spool with paired cyan end caps and an oval hook.

jackpot_item.name: Wormhole junction relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Junction coordinate
quest_item.shape: Two numbered portal plates connected by a short cyan bar

worlds.name: Dark matter reef
worlds.mechanic: Reveal and tune phase-sensitive seams. Entry income is ordinary physical rock; phase barriers begin beyond M1. Invisible solid terrain always has a faint contact boundary.
worlds.hazard: Unmatched resonance barrier hit 72 HP with 2 s warning before activation. Three frequencies use circle, triangle and square marks in addition to colour.
worlds.shape: Translucent faceted faces over opaque collision outlines; large quiet negative spaces between reefs.
worlds.rig: Forked scanner antenna, a floating but visibly attached cutter ring and a broad frequency dial.
worlds.light: Violet ambient glow stays below the rig headlamp. Matched seams become opaque and gain a patterned outline.
worlds.fx: Resonance pulses stop at their useful radius; no random screen noise or seizure-like flicker.
worlds.audio: Three distinct musical intervals encode frequencies, paired with the same three visual shapes.
milestones: Read the first reef
Reveal and collect five already exposed sample capsules within 350 m, then bank them. No phase cutting is required. Unlock R2.
Tune the three frequencies
Complete one matching cut at each marked frequency near 1300 m. Unlock R3.
Extract the resonance key
Retrieve the key at 2600 m and finish the resonance beacon. Grant Rift certificate; open W11.

gear.name: Resonance probe
gear.effect: Reveal phase seams within 7 cells for 8 s; 10 s cooldown, 0.35 energy/pulse.
gear.art: Forked probe with three large frequency shapes on its collar.

gear.name: Frequency tuner
gear.effect: Switch among three frequencies in 0.4 s. Matched phase material becomes cuttable and takes normal damage; unmatched remains protected.
gear.art: Three-position mechanical dial with circle, triangle and square marks.

gear.name: Phase cutter
gear.effect: Matched phase material cut time x0.55; active tool energy x1.20. Cannot bypass mission locks or solid unmatched barriers.
gear.art: Open triangular cutter with a solid inner blade that appears only when matched.

jackpot_item.name: Dark matter reef relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Resonance key
quest_item.shape: Three interlocked circle triangle and square plates surrounding a violet shard

worlds.name: Mirror dimension
worlds.mechanic: Two linked terrain layers share the same coordinate grid. Excavating support in one layer may open a route in the other; causal links are previewed.
worlds.hazard: Linked fracture hit 126 HP after 3 s warning. Shifting into solid terrain is blocked without cost; nearby safe destinations are previewed.
worlds.shape: Paired terraces with mirrored offsets. The inactive layer uses outlines and hatching rather than transparency alone.
worlds.rig: Paired teal and rose fins with one solid central cabin. Layer state changes fins and a clear A or B marker.
worlds.light: Active layer has full contrast; inactive layer remains faint and patterned. Hazards retain the shared warning treatment.
worlds.fx: Short cross-layer echo at the rig only. Linked terrain changes animate over 0.5 s so the cause stays visible.
worlds.audio: Two variations of one musical phrase and a distinct safe-shift confirmation.
milestones: Map the paired shaft
Scan three marked linked supports within 400 m. Unlock R2 and a two-layer refuge.
Open the mirrored vault
Excavate the three indicated supports across both layers at 1400 m. Unlock R3.
Recover both halves
Bank the coordinate halves from the two 2600 m chambers and finish the phase dock. Grant Genesis certificate; open W15.

gear.name: Paired scanner
gear.effect: Preview terrain in the other layer within 6 cells, including linked supports; 8 s cooldown, 0.3 energy/pulse.
gear.art: Two offset dishes with alternating solid and hatched faces.

gear.name: Dual phase drive
gear.effect: Shift to the other layer on a valid empty cell; 8 s cooldown and 1.0 energy. Cannot shift while cutting.
gear.art: Two swept fins around the cabin with a large A/B status disc.

gear.name: Cross layer anchor
gear.effect: Place one persistent refuge anchor valid in both layers; return to it from within 12 cells, 30 s cooldown, 2 energy. No sale or refill on use.
gear.art: Symmetric twin prongs joined by an ivory central block and paired floor pads.

jackpot_item.name: Mirror dimension relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Paired coordinate
quest_item.shape: Two interlocking half-discs one hatched and one solid in a single mission frame

worlds.name: Fossilized time world
worlds.mechanic: Each marked time pocket cycles through molten, solid and fractured states every 12 s, with a 3 s transition warning. Temporal actions never recreate sold ore or rewind inventory.
worlds.hazard: Chronal pulse hit 100 HP after 3 s warning. Time pockets are bounded within 6-cell rooms; the rest of the map remains stable.
worlds.shape: Large sediment rings, embedded fossils and repeated silhouettes frozen in sequence. Keep the play layer crisp.
worlds.rig: Brass clamps, ivory preservation chamber and a broad clock-like ring with three discrete positions.
worlds.light: Amber local light and cool stable refuges. State changes alter texture and a shape badge, not brightness alone.
worlds.fx: Three discrete terrain transitions; no full-screen reversing motion. Ore ownership state stays visually marked.
worlds.audio: Clock-like clicks without constant ticking, reversed dust sound only during a state change.
milestones: Record the first pocket
Observe all three states of the marked 350 m pocket and bank its survey. Unlock R2.
Extract the preserved sample
Use the fractured state to recover the marked 1400 m sample intact. Unlock R3 and a stable refuge.
Recover the chronal coordinate
Traverse the three-state vault at 2600 m and bank the coordinate. Grant Genesis certificate; open W15.

gear.name: Temporal clamp
gear.effect: Hold a marked pocket in its current state for 8 s; 16 s cooldown; 0.5 energy/activation.
gear.art: Two brass jaws around a three-position timing ring.

gear.name: State selector
gear.effect: Advance an eligible pocket one state; 10 s cooldown, 0.8 energy. Changes no cargo, credits, timers outside the pocket or depleted ore flags.
gear.art: Three clear state plates showing liquid, block and fractured block.

gear.name: Preservation chamber
gear.effect: Intact chronal ordinary deposits sell for +25%; no jackpot or mission multiplier. Reduces chronal cargo mass by 20%.
gear.art: Ivory capsule holding an amber fragment between three static rings.

jackpot_item.name: Fossilized time world relic
jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

quest_item.name: Chronal coordinate
quest_item.shape: Three amber fossil plates with one clearly preserved clock-like spiral

worlds.name: Reality foundry
worlds.mechanic: Use bounded matter operations to excavate the world forge. The final sequence tests routes, extraction, energy and cargo control before world creation becomes available.
worlds.hazard: Causal fault hit 140 HP after 3 s warning. Built material cannot cover exits, the rig, mission sockets or unbanked objects. All final rooms have safe retreat points.
worlds.shape: Pale mineral architecture, large geometric cavities and pearl tetrahedra. Preserve heavy stone weight beneath the unusual geometry.
worlds.rig: Pale ceramic panels, bifurcated cutter and subtle paired phase fins; the original orange stripe is preserved.
worlds.light: Pearl highlights are sparse. Teal energy seams guide the eye to machinery, and the finale avoids a whiteout.
worlds.fx: Matter assembles in three readable steps. Causal links draw briefly from the tool to the affected cell.
worlds.audio: Earlier motor motifs return inside a wider harmonic texture; final completion leaves a quiet mining ambience.
milestones: Restore the assembly chamber
Bank five marked alloy samples and clear the 500 m forge room. Unlock R2 and the assembly dock.
Rebuild the causal bridge
Place three approved blocks across the 1800 m fault and recover its regulator. Unlock R3.
Create the world seed
Recover three forge components from the 2400-3200 m rooms, bank them, and complete the final assembly. End campaign; unlock custom claims.

gear.name: Causality cutter
gear.effect: Cut marked causal seams at time x0.65. Can sever one previewed terrain link per 12 s, cost 1 energy; no mission socket deletion.
gear.art: Bifurcated pale blade with teal and rose tips and a solid central mounting bar.

gear.name: Matter assembler
gear.effect: Place up to 6 approved structural blocks per expedition on discovered empty cells; each costs 1 energy. Blocks have zero resale and generate no ore.
gear.art: Two opposed ivory jaws with a visible cubic construction volume.

gear.name: World seed chamber
gear.effect: Unlocks the final forge action after M3 components are banked. After completion, enables custom claim generation with two chosen modifiers. No combat stat multiplier.
gear.art: A pearl tetrahedron floating inside a heavy brass-and-ivory frame; slow stable glow.

jackpot_item.shape: five-point broken ring enclosing a solid core

units.energy: L equivalent before stellar era; displayed as charge later with identical accounting
units.cargo: bulk capacity; packages occupy 1 to 16 units, according to their origin

rules.cut_seconds: direction * material * (1+depth/800) / (drill_speed/2), then active tool multiplier; cap resistance at 5 outside W04
